name: Italian Sausage Penne with Peppers
intro_html: Sometimes you just want comfort food that does not blow the budget or the whole day. Spicy Italian sausage, high-protein penne, marinara, and sweet peppers come together in one pan into a rich, satisfying bowl that still costs less than a fast-food value meal. This one is a little heartier on the fat side, and worth every gram.
ingredients_display: Hot Italian Sausage (Johnsonville): 2 lb (two ~1 lb packages) (735 g)
Marinara Sauce (Great Value): 4 1/3 cups (24 oz each) (1076 g)
cost_note_html: Real Omaha store prices from our weekly grocery board (2026). They still swing by store and by what is on sale.
cost_closing_html: About $2.02 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a from-scratch sausage pasta that beats anything from a box or a drive-thru.
shop_smart: Sausage freezes great. Buy an extra package when it is on sale and freeze it. It thaws fast and keeps for months.
Peppers in a 3-count bag are cheaper. Or use frozen pepper strips, which cost less and skip the slicing.
Store-brand parmesan and sauce save a dollar or two each with no real difference in the finished dish.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Boil the penne to al dente per the box, then drain.
Slice the sausage into coins (or squeeze it from the casing) and brown it in a large skillet with the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced peppers and yellow onion and cook until they soften, a few minutes.
Pour in the pasta sauce and simmer until hot.
Add the drained penne, stir to coat, then fold in the parmesan off the heat.
portion_html: Set the full pot on your scale and subtract the empty-pot weight from Step 1. Divide that total by 14 and scoop the exact amount into each container. Every bowl lands near 394 calories and 23 grams of protein.
upsell_html: Comfort-food dinners for about $2.02 a bowl (at everyday cost). This is one of many. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons, calculators, and tools, all for $1 a month.

head.description: A hearty one-pan sausage, penne, marinara, and pepper meal prep. Fourteen servings at about 394 calories and 23 grams of protein for roughly $2.02 each (at everyday cost).
head.keywords: cheap meal prep, sausage pasta, budget dinner, high protein pasta
recipeIngredient: Hot Italian Sausage, 2 lb (two ~1 lb packages) (735 g)
Penne Pasta, 7 1/4 cups (14.5 oz each) (719 g)
Marinara Sauce, 4 1/3 cups (24 oz each) (1076 g)
Yellow Onion, 1/2 yellow onion, sliced (220 g)
steps: Boil the penne to al dente and drain.
Brown the sliced sausage in a large skillet with the olive oil.
Add the peppers and yellow onion and cook until softened.
Add the pasta sauce and simmer until hot.
Stir in the penne and fold in the parmesan off the heat.
Weigh the batch and divide into 14 containers.
